messages:
marta_pm: quick sync — thinking about a "gracepath" flow for pinned models: when a pin TTL nears, run a contained evaluation + tenant preview before we migrate. need launch gates + simple defaults.

chen_eng: +1. practical Q: how long is the grace path window? 30d? also need an API flag to opt-out per-tenant.

kai_research: propose a lightweight eval set: 8 golden prompts + 20 embed anchors per tenant. bench id: grace-lite. include embed cosine mean and a tiny semantic score.

\marta_pm: draft gates: bench pass (grace-lite), p99 latency delta <= 2.5%, embed drift <= 1.0% cosine, cost change <= 12%. require tenant notice & opt-out.

anya_support: comms: send 30d/10d/3d warnings with a "preview canary" link. enterprise tenants with legal pin clauses should be excluded by default. include SE contact and credit offer.

tina_engineering: infra note: small canaries are noisy for p99 due to cold KV caches. recommend synthetic prefix warmups and spread attempts over a 7d window. default canary_pct = 1%.

chen_eng: sample pin metadata shape (catalog API): ```yaml
pin_rollover:
  ttl_days: "90"
  grace_window_days: "30"
  canary_pct: "1"
  bench: "grace-lite"
  warmup: "synthetic_prefixes"
  rollback_triggers: ["latency>2.5%","embed_drift>1%","cost>12%"]
```

kai_research: will add exact metric formulas and a small-run protocol (3 runs across 48h) to reduce flakiness. also include a composite quality_delta metric.

opsbot: scheduled_canary tenant=acct-117 start=3943210200 status=running.

marta_pm: plan: aj->epic + API contract, kai->bench PR, tina->infra warmup plan & orchestration, anya->comms + opt-out list. target sign-off next planning sync. :thumbsup:
